notes.title: Dread of Laughter has been remade
notes.content:
[h1]Dread of Laughter has been remade![/h1]

Dread of Laughter has been remade to be longer, much more user-friendly and the old version's problems have been addressed. This includes full on working save system and better checkpoints so the player doesn't have to re-do as much anymore after dying.

[b]Major improvements in the new version of the game[/b]

-The game has proper tutorials in the beginning that will teach the player the mechanics.
-Longer gameplay before the house and new areas to explore
-Fixed every game breaking bug that was present in the older version of the game
-More secrets in the map. Can you find out what happened in the farm?
-Achievements have been made to work
-In the main menu you can now continue your progress by loading your previous games or start a completely new one.
-You can now properly hide from enemies behind rocks, tables and inside the closets! 
- Enemy speed has been lowered at the beginning to give the player more chances of surviving and hiding.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Huge Update
notes.content:
Our latest update is live! It will bring more content inside and outside the house, whole new beginning to let the player learn controls before anything major is going to happen.

What this patch will bring:

- New beginning
- More content inside the house
- More content outside the house
- Save doll visible everywhere where there is savepoint

notes.title: Patch Notes - More Save Areas
notes.content:
Todays patch adds the save system to the basement. We heard a lot of feedback and decided to add another save location there. 

List of changes included in the update

- Save in basement (touch the doll to save, this also applies in the safehouse)
- Bug fixes
- Few more special secrets added to beat the game

- Few more special secrets added to beat the game

notes.title: Patch Notes - Save System & More
notes.content:
Todays patch will bring the long asked save system along with other things. Do note that this save system still requires few tweaks and improvements that are coming soon. Right now it is the "raw" version so the players inventory doesn't save. Although it will not affect the gameplay as everything needed is either inside the safehouse or in the outside area of the map. 

This patch will bring:

- Saving system in the safehouse
- Basement improvements
- Improved Main Menu

We had to delay the crafting as we are focusing on the save system. We're a team of 2 people so everything will come as fast as we can make them. 100% functional save and crafting will most likely come next week!

tags.feature: - Saving system in the safehouse
- Basement improvements
- Improved Main Menu

notes.title: Patch Notes - What's this!? What's that!?
notes.content:
We've gone through quite a lot of feedback and made few adjustments and bug fixes that the majority has been reporting.

- Outdoor area is a lot bigger, few new areas to explore
- No more constant WHATS THIS? WHATS THAT? audio cues
- RNG Keyspawns scrapped, there are still few randomly generated mechanics but the beginning keys are now in one spot. This doesn't mean that the rooms where the key won't be are not important
- We made a safehouse with crafting possibilities coming in future
- Killer run speed lowered by 25-35%. Makes it possible to run away from them outside
- More story elements
- More encounters
- Every bug seen from livestreams and feedback is fixed, this also includes animations
- Footsteps now have their corresponding sounds depending on the surface

Thank you for your feedback, it is highly appreciated!

notes.title: Gameplay Improvements
notes.content:
Today's patch brings few gameplay fixes and changes. We've heard a lot of feedback; positive and negative and we're going through everything in order to improve the game for everybody.

Changes and bug fixes

- Upstair keys are no longer random generated
- AI sounds have been improved. No more looping sounds
- Better death screen
- More puzzles in the early game 
- More outdoor content and puzzles
- Secrets
- AI pathing changes

We have also scheduled another patch to come out tomorrow! Thank you all for your feedback, it helps us greatly to fix bugs and improve our game.
